terra.problem: The claim that the Assyrians were a powerful nation is outside the passage and has no reference.
The identification of the Philistines as a nation is outside the passage and has no reference.
The explanation that burnt offerings were gifts brought to the altar adds a Bible fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The passage does not say that this band of priests was set apart to serve at God's house.
The claim that shepherds come up throughout the Bible has no supporting reference.
The verse says the anger blazes in the morning, not specifically at sunrise.
